# Total.js conventions: every page

> How Total.js 5 applications are written: ES5 over ES6, Total.js prototypes and Tangular first, no imports from Node.js, pipe-separated action and schema names, explicit or action-declared routes, recognizable runtime/private/docs folders, MODS module access, existing storage and DATA queries, PostgreSQL scripts and jComponent components loaded with COMPONENTATOR(). Learned from inspected Total.js 5 app snapshots and framework source.

---

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/README.md

# Total.js conventions

How Total.js 5 applications are written, learned from inspected app snapshots, framework source and the official style guide. It is a reference for people and for AI agents: read the zone you are working in, copy the pattern, keep the names.

The reference apps are CMS, OpenPlatform, Todomator, Dashboard, FlowOS and IoT. [Sources and scope](general/sources.md) records the inspected files and distinguishes observed patterns, repository defaults and framework behaviour. This is a maintained community reference, not a claim that every rule has been approved by Total.js.

## Zones

Each zone is a folder. Read the general rules, then the pages relevant to your change.

| Zone | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [`general/`](general) | Project layout, JavaScript style, naming. Applies everywhere. |
| [`backend/`](backend) | Actions, routes, authentication, definitions, modules, gotchas of the server. |
| [`database/`](database) | PostgreSQL scripts and how the code queries them with `DATA`. |
| [`frontend/`](frontend) | jComponent components (use the existing ones, `COMPONENTATOR()`), plugins with UI, views and layouts, CSS. |

## Pages

- general: [sources](general/sources.md), [workflow](general/workflow.md), [native-patterns](general/native-patterns.md), [project-structure](general/project-structure.md), [javascript-style](general/javascript-style.md)
- backend: [storage-and-integrations](backend/storage-and-integrations.md), [actions](backend/actions.md), [routes-and-auth](backend/routes-and-auth.md), [definitions-and-modules](backend/definitions-and-modules.md), [gotchas](backend/gotchas.md)
- database: [sql-scripts](database/sql-scripts.md), [queries](database/queries.md)
- frontend: [binding-and-forms](frontend/binding-and-forms.md), [components](frontend/components.md), [plugins-ui](frontend/plugins-ui.md), [views-and-layout](frontend/views-and-layout.md), [css](frontend/css.md)

## For AI agents

- [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md): how to use these pages and the rules for every change (also `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md` and `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, which point to it).
- [`llms.txt`](llms.txt): an index with a link to every page; [`llms-full.txt`](llms-full.txt): every page in one file.
- Skills to write and to review code with these conventions: `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`.

## Principles

1. **ES5 over ES6**: `var`, `function`, classic loops. ES6 only when there is no ES5 way.
2. **Total.js first**: prototypes (`'{0}'.format()`, `findItem()`, `parseJSON()`...) in the backend and Tangular in the frontend, before any other function.
3. **No imports from Node.js**: use `Total.Fs`, `Total.Path`, `Total.Crypto`... instead of `require()`.
4. Keep runtime code and inputs in recognizable Total.js folders. Use `private/` for internal runtime files, `docs/` for development material, and `MODS` for loaded application modules. Follow the code that is already next to yours. A new file looks like its neighbours.
5. Keep names short, lowercase and the same across projects: `id`, `name`, `body`, `dtcreated`, `items`. Use `|` between parts of action and schema names (`Tickets|list`, `@Reports|Categories`), never `/` or `\`.
6. Declare types once (`input:` / `params:` / `query:`). In the action, still check ownership, permissions, existence and business constraints.
7. Follow the app's route registration pattern: explicit `ROUTE()` or the action's `route:`. Keep business logic in actions and use the existing storage model.
8. Add no dependency that the framework already covers.
9. Check what you changed: `node --check file.js`, then run the app and call the route.

## Creating and correcting apps

Start with the [write and refactor workflow](general/workflow.md). It covers choosing a reference, preserving contracts, reviewing existing code and recording checks. Use [native patterns](general/native-patterns.md) to replace unnecessary wrappers, [storage and integrations](backend/storage-and-integrations.md) for persistence and outgoing HTTP, and [binding and forms](frontend/binding-and-forms.md) for a complete UI flow. A conventions check does not certify runtime correctness.

## Versions

Written for **Total.js 5** (`total5` on npm). The official guidelines were written for Total.js 4 (including schema examples); the pages mark the places where Total.js 5 code differs. Do not assume a Total.js 4 API exists in version 5: check the framework source or an existing app.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE). The examples are short excerpts adapted from Total.js CMS and Total.js OpenPlatform (MIT, Copyright Peter Širka / Total.js) and from Todomator (MIT), kept to illustrate the conventions.

# AGENTS.md

This repository is a reference of conventions for Total.js 5 applications. Read it before writing or changing Total.js code.

## How to use it

1. Open [README.md](README.md) and pick the zone you work in: `general/`, `backend/`, `database/` or `frontend/`.
2. Read the general rules and the pages for the affected zones. Start with `general/sources.md` and `general/workflow.md` when choosing a pattern or correcting existing code.
3. Copy the pattern of the nearest existing file in the project you are editing; use these pages to decide what is idiomatic.

## Rules that apply to every change

- Total.js 5 only. Do not use Total.js 4 APIs.
- Repository default for new code — ES5 over ES6: `var`, `function`, classic loops, `'{0}'.format()` instead of template literals. ES6 only when there is no ES5 way.
- Use Total.js prototypes (`findItem`, `format`, `parseJSON`, `slug`, `isEmail`...) in the backend and Tangular templates in the frontend before any other function.
- In initialized app code, do not `require()` exposed Node.js modules: use `Total.Fs`, `Total.Path`, `Total.Crypto`, `Total.Os`, `Total.Zlib`, etc.
- Runtime code and inputs use recognizable Total.js folders; internal runtime files belong under `private/`, and development documentation, evaluations and standalone examples under `docs/`. The running app must not depend on `docs/`. Update readers, exports, tests and deployment allowlists when moving files.
- Loaded application modules are accessed through `MODS`, not repeated path-based imports. Preserve direct imports in standalone tools and respect module-loading order; see `backend/definitions-and-modules.md`.
- Tabs, semicolons, `'` for short strings, lowercase file names with `-`.
- Use `|` as the separator in action and schema names: `Tickets|list`, `Reports|Categories|list`, `@Reports|Categories`. Do not use `/` or `\` as name separators. When correcting an existing name, update registrations and every caller together, checking generated endpoints and compatibility. See `backend/actions.md`.
- Follow the app's route style: explicit `ROUTE()` or an action's `route:`. Never register the same endpoint twice.
- Keep the existing storage model: `DATA` for SQL, `FILESTORAGE` for files/CMS metadata, `MEMORIZE` where the app uses it. In request queries use `.promise($)` / `.callback($)`; ids are `UID()`, dates are `NOW`.
- Verify APIs against the installed Total.js and UI versions; the source apps mix versions and patterns. Distinguish repository policy from a framework requirement.
- Preserve URLs, permissions, input/output shapes, settings keys and model paths during a style correction. Do not add an abstraction when a direct native call fits; see `general/native-patterns.md`.
- Frontend: match the app's jComponent major version; use an existing jComponent component (catalogue: https://forge.totaljs.es/es/components/, markdown at `https://forge.totaljs.es/en/components/<name>.md`); if none exists, create a reusable `COMPONENT('name', ...)`. Load catalogue components with `COMPONENTATOR()`; load app-owned components from app assets.
- Every text for people is `@(Text)`.
- After editing JavaScript run `node --check file.js`; start the app and call the route you changed.

## Layout

- `general/`, `backend/`, `database/`, `frontend/`: the pages, one folder per zone.
- `llms.txt` (index) and `llms-full.txt` (every page in one file): for models. They are generated, do not edit them by hand.
- `scripts/llms.js`: builds the two files above and lists the pages in order.
- `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`: the skills to write and to review Total.js 5 code with these conventions.
- `tests/`: tests of the files for agents and of the links of the pages.

## Using these conventions from another project

Point your agent at `llms.txt` (an index with a link to every page) or at `llms-full.txt` (all the pages at once):

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/llms.txt
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/llms-full.txt

A project can add a line to its own `AGENTS.md`: "Follow the Total.js 5 conventions of https://github.com/totaljs-es/conventions".

## Checking this repository

- `npm test` checks that the pointers and skills exist, that every page is listed in `llms.txt`, that `llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt` match the pages, and that every link works.
- After you change or add a page, run `npm run llms` and `npm test`. A new page is also added to the list in `scripts/llms.js`.

## Keeping these pages true

Every rule here comes from code that exists. When you add a rule, add an example from a real file or from the framework source, and say which.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/conventions/main/general/sources.md

# Sources and scope

Reviewed on 2026-11-03 against six downloaded Total.js 5 application snapshots and local framework source. The downloads have no Git history, so folder names such as `main` are not revision identifiers. `sources.json` records SHA-256 hashes for the specific files used; it does not claim to inventory every app file. Verify current behaviour against the target app's installed dependency, especially when `package.json` says `latest` or `beta`.

## What a rule means

- **Observed pattern:** present in the listed app files. Follow the nearest compatible example in the target app.
- **Repository default:** a choice for new code here, such as ES5 preference, pipe action IDs and dated SQL upgrades. It is not evidence that every Total.js app uses that choice.
- **Framework behaviour:** confirmed in the inspected framework source. Check the installed revision before depending on it.

Current project requirements and explicit user instructions take priority. Preserve existing contracts while correcting style. This reference cannot guarantee approval by an individual reviewer.

## Reference map

Paths below are relative to each downloaded app root. Public links are navigation aids; the hashes describe the local inspected files, not the current remote branch.

| App | Files to start with | Demonstrated pattern |
|---|---|---|
| [CMS](https://github.com/totaljs/cms) | `plugins/redirects/index.js`, `plugins/redirects/schemas/redirects.js`, `plugins/redirects/public/index.html`, `plugins/redirects/public/form.html`, `definitions/func.js`, `definitions/init.js`, `views/admin.html` | Explicit routes, slash action IDs, FileStorage metadata, plugin/form flow, jComponent 19 shell |
| [OpenPlatform](https://github.com/totaljs/openplatform) | `plugins/setup/schemas/groups.js`, `plugins/setup/index.js`, `database.sql`, `database-2024-10-30.sql` | Shared input, SQL actions, route params, dated upgrades |
| [Todomator](https://github.com/totaljs/todomator) | `schemas/tickets.js`, `definitions/init.js`, `definitions/func.js`, `views/index.html`, `views/login.html` | Grouped and standalone actions, ownership filters, `$.done`, service/configure events, different UI shells |
| Dashboard | `plugins/views/index.js`, `plugins/views/public/form.html`, `modules/openplatform.js`, `views/admin.html` | Actions with `route:` in plugin entry, pipe IDs, MEMORIZE, jComponent 20 |
| FlowOS | `definitions/init.js`, `views/index.html` | Flow persistence, websocket permissions, local jComponent 20 assets |
| IoT | `admin/plugins/devices/schemas/devices.js`, `admin/plugins/dataviews/index.js`, `admin/views/admin.html` | `route:` in schema files, paginated lists, permissions, jComponent 20 |

Dashboard and FlowOS declare a Total.js Enterprise license. They and IoT were inspected for patterns; this reference adds no source excerpts from those apps and grants no rights to redistribute them. The code excerpts added here are adapted from the MIT apps or are illustrative combinations explicitly identified as such. Avoid copying bundled libraries, configuration secrets or runtime data into this repository.

## Framework checks

In [Total.js framework5](https://github.com/totaljs/framework5):

- `index.js`, module loading, and `global.js`: automatic registration in `F.modules`, its `MODS` alias, module IDs and optional `install()`; sibling initialization still requires lifecycle care. CMS `plugins/dashboard/schemas/dashboard.js` demonstrates `MODS.visitors` in actions.
- `index.js`, module initialization: `Total.Os`, `Total.Fs`, `Total.Path` and the other native module aliases; `COMPONENTATOR` and `MEMORIZE` implementations.
- `builders.js`, `exports.newaction` and action execution: automatic routes, `user`, `sa` and `permissions`; `Options.prototype.invalid`, `done` and action calling.
- `mcp.js`, tool-name sanitizer: `/` and `|` both become `_`; this is independent of this repository's `|` naming convention. Name corrections require coordinated caller and endpoint updates.
- `querybuilder.js`, `QBP.promise`, `callback`, `autoquery` and `CTP.list`: error flow and query operations.
- `controller.js`, `callback`, `invalid`, `csrf` and payload handling: controller APIs differ from action APIs.

The [official guidelines](https://github.com/totaljs-es/guidelines) remain a style reference; their older examples do not decide v5 API availability.

## Maintaining evidence

When adding a rule, record the file and operation that support it. Label an adapted example and describe any deliberate change (such as converting arrows to functions). When sources disagree, document the alternatives instead of silently presenting one as universal. Update hashes after a new source review; a matching hash proves file identity, not correctness or production readiness.

Verify the recorded files without modifying them:

```bash
node scripts/check-sources.js --apps /path/to/downloaded/apps --framework /path/to/framework5
```

Run this from the conventions repository root. Exit 0 means the selected files match, 1 means drift or missing files, and 2 means invalid arguments. It requires local reference copies; `npm test` uses isolated fixtures and does not need those apps.

## Forge organization policy

The Forge application reorganization inspected on 2026-11-03 supplies a concrete maintained-project example for `private/languages.json`, `private/database/`, `docs/evaluations/`, `docs/findings/` and the subsequent standalone-example placement under `docs/examples/`. Runtime language reading, SQL startup, exports, isolated application copies and deployment allowlists were updated together. Application module consumers use `MODS`; standalone Node maintenance tools retain direct imports.

Sources in Forge: `AGENTS.md`, `modules/i18n.js`, `modules/content-snapshot.js`, `definitions/benchmarks.js`, `controllers/default.js`, `tools/make-package.js`, `tools/with-test-app.js` and the standalone taskboard reference. The folder grouping is an adopted repository policy illustrated by Forge, not a claim that all inspected Total.js apps have identical directories or that Total.js forbids extra directories. Existing root SQL files, public asset contracts and legacy migration inputs remain separate considerations.

## Forge frontend example

Forge commit `827311e` is the concrete reference for CDN jComponent 20 loading, separate `ui`/`webui` component bundles, official BackToTop with a scoped skin and a native accessibility initialization hook. Inspect `views/layout.html`, `views/admin.html`, `definitions/ui.js`, `public/js/func.js` and `public/css/components.css` together. The pinned `vendor/components-master/j-BackToTop/` source and upstream `jComponent/library.js` explain generated markup and `$init` timing. This extends the earlier application snapshots; it does not change their recorded UI versions or claim that all apps use the same frontend shell.
